claim: The Venetian Macao gondola ride is a 20-minute serenaded boat ride on indoor canals or the outdoor lagoon beneath a painted sky
quote: cruise the canals of Shoppes at Venetian or the outdoor lagoon, meandering along serene indoor waterways

claim: Venetian gondola adult tickets cost MOP165 weekdays / MOP175 weekends / MOP195 holidays; private boats MOP788-988
quote: Adult tickets (12 years and above) cost MOP165 on weekdays, MOP175 on weekends, and MOP195 on public holidays... Private boat options... MOP788 on weekdays, MOP888 on weekends, and MOP988 on public holidays

claim: Studio City's Golden Reel is the world's highest figure-8 Ferris wheel at 130m; standard ticket MOP100; open 14:00-20:00, closed Tue/Wed
quote: Standard Ticket: MOP 100 ... reaches 130 meters into the air, making it the world's highest figure-8 Ferris wheel ... 14:00 - 20:00 (Closed on Tuesday and Wednesday)

claim: Studio City Water Park day pass is around MOP388 adult, rising to MOP650 in peak summer; kids under 1m free
quote: The day pass price is MOP $388 for adults... Summer prices are $650 for adults... Children below 1 meter get in for free

claim: Galaxy Macau's 75,000 sqm Grand Resort Deck reopened April 3 2026 with the world's longest Skytop aquatic river ride (575m) and largest Skytop wave pool (8,000 sqm)
quote: Grand Resort Deck spans 75,000 square meters and boasts the world's longest Skytop Aquatic Adventure River Ride at 575 meters and the world's largest Skytop Wave Pool covering 8,000 square meters

claim: Galaxy hotel guests get free Grand Resort Deck access (valued MOP888); day-visitor packages start MOP468 for one adult + one kid
quote: Hotel guests can enjoy free access to Grand Resort Deck (valued at MOP888)... Package 1 starts from MOP 468 for one adult and one kid

claim: The Londoner Macao stages a Changing of the Guard show six days a week with 20+ artists in its Crystal Palace atrium, plus hourly Big Ben facade light-and-sound shows
quote: Changing of the Guard entertainment extravaganza, recreating the dramatic display of British pageantry at the London-themed property's stunning Crystal Palace lobby atrium... performed six days a week, with over 20 artists

claim: City of Dreams' reimagined House of Dancing Water runs Wed-Sun, 90 minutes no intermission, with new choreography by Giuliano Peparini
quote: operates Wednesday to Sunday, and has a duration of 90 minutes with no intermission... updated choreography by Giuliano Peparini

claim: City of Dreams' non-gambling offerings include the 17,000 sqft four-zone Kids' City play area, Dream Avenue shopping, and a contemporary art collection
quote: Kids' City: Covering 17,000 square feet... offers adventure in four zones: Dream, Excite, Create and Explore

claim: Studio City's FUNtastic Four bundle (MOP618, valued MOP960) combines Water Park entry, Golden Reel ride, Super Fun Zone and a movie voucher
quote: FUNtastic Four Package available for MOP 618 (valued at MOP 960) that includes access to the Water Park, a ride on the Golden Reel Ferris Wheel, exploration of the Super Fun Zone, and a movie voucher
